    MEditor
    Multi-line editor with: - a fast-scroll strip on the right edge (linear mapping of touch Y to scroll position), - drag scrolling with fling, implemented on top of the native EditText scroll, - a "first tap" focus guard so the keyboard does not pop up unexpectedly, - an external read-only mode.
